name: Dead Sky, CA
source:
Dead Sky, CA,  June 15th 1991. Your fist day living life independently.  At first, you feel liberated, but as the true nature of your town begins to show, you learn to trust nothing. You find yourself unexpectedly thrust into a dark and damaging illicit party scene as the comfort  of suburban life ebbs away as those you've trusted throughout your life here reveal their true colours.
